prompt: Our onboarding flow has a 60% drop-off at the account-verification step. We've already tried shortening the form and adding a progress bar. I'm out of ideas — what else could we do?
assertions: Runs the lighter/fast mode rather than a full multi-agent deep run, or explicitly justifies going deep
Reframes the problem as a function rather than accepting 'fix the verification step' at face value
Explicitly avoids re-proposing the two things the user already tried
Produces options that differ in mechanism, not just in UI wording or visual design
At least one option questions whether verification needs to happen at that point in the flow at all
Does not pad the answer with framework section headings that contain no mechanism
